description: Molecular reorientation of a liquid (CS2 values)

response.source: h(t) = (exp(-t/1.6 ps) - exp(-t/0.2 ps)) / 1.4 ps: typical CS2 values of the original code (decay ~1.6-2 ps is the commonly quoted reorientation time); the rise time and the exact decay are unverified; 1.5 = purely orientational (h_a = -h_b/3)
